summary: Build ISO/IEC 27035 incident management fundamentals and prepare for the PECB Foundation exam in this two-day course.
audienceIntro: ISO/IEC 27035 Foundation is for people who support incident management processes or want to build a grounding in their principles and approaches.
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of security incident management is preferred. The PECB certification requirements list no professional experience, management-system audit or assessment experience, or information security incident management system project experience for the Foundation designation. Passing the exam and signing the PECB Code of Ethics are required to apply for the credential.
